def compute_value(n, memo={}):
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    if n <= 11:
        return min(n, 2 + (11 - n))
    base = 1
    depth = 1
    while base <= n:
        base = base * 10 + 1
        depth += 1
    limit = base // 10
    if base > 2 * n:
        times = n // limit
        rem = n % limit
        optionA = compute_value(base - n, memo) + depth
        optionB = times * (depth - 1) + compute_value(rem, memo)
        memo[n] = min(optionA, optionB)
        return memo[n]
    else:
        times = n // limit
        rem = n % limit
        optionA = compute_value(base - n, memo) + depth
        optionB = times * (depth - 1) + compute_value(rem, memo)
        memo[n] = min(optionA, optionB)
        return memo[n]
